select sku.id, sku.item_id, sku.sku_name, sku.spec_model, sku.status, sku.create_by, sku.create_time, sku.update_by, sku.update_time, item.id as item_id_ref, item.item_code, item.item_name, item.item_category, item.unit as item_unit, item.equipment_name, item.equipment_type, item.status as item_status, item.remark as item_remark from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id inner join wms_item_category category on item.item_category=category.id
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and item.item_code like concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
and item.equipment_name like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentName}, '%')
and sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
and sku.spec_model like concat('%', #{bo.specModel}, '%')
and (category.id=#{bo.itemCategory} or category.parent_id=#{bo.itemCategory})
order by sku.item_id desc
